SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff' THEN T3.cost ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) * 100 / SUM(T3.cost) FROM event AS T1 INNER JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event INNER JOIN expense AS T3 ON T2.budget_id = T3.link_to_budget

SELECT DISTINCT T.element FROM atom AS T WHERE NOT T.element IN (SELECT DISTINCT T1.element FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id)-- Get unique elements not connected to any atom

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.PT >= 14 AND T1.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE DATE_FORMAT(CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS DATETIME), '%Y') - DATE_FORMAT(CAST(T1.Birthday AS DATETIME), '%Y') > 55

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.category = 'Parking' THEN T1.amount ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) * 100 / SUM(T1.amount) FROM budget AS T1 INNER JOIN event AS T2 ON T1.link_to_event = T2.event_id WHERE T2.event_name = 'November Speaker'

SELECT SUBSTRING(T2.Date, 1, 4) FROM customers AS T1 INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE T1.Currency = 'CZK' GROUP BY SUBSTRING(T2.Date, 1, 4) ORDER BY SUM(T2.Consumption) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT T2.major_name FROM member AS T1 INNER JOIN major AS T2 ON T1.link_to_major = T2.major_id WHERE T1.position = 'Vice President'

SELECT T1.name, T1.year FROM races AS T1 INNER JOIN lapTimes AS T2 ON T2.raceId = T1.raceId INNER JOIN drivers AS T3 ON T3.driverId = T2.driverId WHERE T3.forename = 'Michael' AND T3.surname = 'Schumacher' ORDER BY T2.milliseconds ASC LIMIT 1

WITH fastest_lap_times AS (SELECT T1.raceId, T1.FastestLapTime, (CAST(SUBSTRING(T1.FastestLapTime, 1, LOCATE(':', T1.FastestLapTime) - 1) AS FLOAT) * 60) + (CAST(SUBSTRING(T1.FastestLapTime, LOCATE(':', T1.FastestLapTime) + 1, LOCATE('.', T1.FastestLapTime) - LOCATE(':', T1.FastestLapTime) - 1) AS FLOAT)) + (CAST(SUBSTRING(T1.FastestLapTime, LOCATE('.', T1.FastestLapTime) + 1) AS FLOAT) / 1000) AS time_in_seconds FROM results AS T1 WHERE NOT T1.FastestLapTime IS NULL) SELECT T1.FastestLapTime AS lap_record FROM results AS T1 INNER JOIN races AS T2 ON T1.raceId = T2.raceId INNER JOIN circuits AS T3 ON T2.circuitId = T3.circuitId INNER JOIN (SELECT MIN(fastest_lap_times.time_in_seconds) AS min_time_in_seconds FROM fastest_lap_times INNER JOIN races AS T2 ON fastest_lap_times.raceId = T2.raceId INNER JOIN circuits AS T3 ON T2.circuitId = T3.circuitId WHERE T3.country = 'Italy') AS T4 ON (CAST(SUBSTRING(T1.FastestLapTime, 1, LOCATE(':', T1.FastestLapTime) - 1) AS FLOAT) * 60) + (CAST(SUBSTRING(T1.FastestLapTime, LOCATE(':', T1.FastestLapTime) + 1, LOCATE('.', T1.FastestLapTime) - LOCATE(':', T1.FastestLapTime) - 1) AS FLOAT)) + (CAST(SUBSTRING(T1.FastestLapTime, LOCATE('.', T1.FastestLapTime) + 1) AS FLOAT) / 1000) = T4.min_time_in_seconds LIMIT 1
